Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# create a few radio frames with plausible 802.15.4 payloads
for n in [10,20,30,40,60,80,100,120,127]:
    data=bytes([0]*n)
    Path(f'/tmp/radio{n}').write_bytes(data)
    print(n)
PY
for f in /tmp/radio10 /tmp/radio20 /tmp/radio30 /tmp/radio40 /tmp/radio60 /tmp/radio80 /tmp/radio100 /tmp/radio120 /tmp/radio127; do echo "== $f =="; bash submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true; done
